This as boutique as possible. Decibelics is a ONE man shop run by Guillem Vilademunt based in his garage in Barcelona, Spain. Guillem began repairing and modifying pedals for himself and for friends around 2010/11. Later he started making some Fuzz, Overdrive and Distortion pedals that he sold to local guitarists or online, as well as mods for Digitech XP Series pedals. In 2012, he got to try an expensive original Klon Centaur Silver. He studied his circuit he started making his first Klones that were so accurate word spread. The original vintage Klon Centaur is a huge pedal. Not to mention quite expensive vintage pedal. Probably one of the most copied pedals around. If you open an original Klon you can see that this box is quite a bit larger than was needed to contain the circuit board and other components. These were built in the days before players had large pedal boards and space has become an issue. In 2016 Guillem took on the challenge to create the most faithful Centaur clone that exists in mini format and with vintage components. Decibelics Golden Horse is a reproduction of the original Klon Centaur adapted to the mini pedal format, Totally handmade by Guillem and loaded with vintage components and N.O.S. (New Old Stock). These pedals are hand built and tested by Guillem so there is some reasonable wait time. On delivery showed the boxing and packaging took as much care as the product. I was quite impressed. The pedal is impeccably built and it is clear Guillem is a talented and caring builder. I have owned and still own quite a few pedals inspired by the Klon. Some are supposedly KLONES are some are “inspired by…” None are mini-sized, except the original Tumnus which is also a great little pedal. So what does it sound like? Fantastic does not describe it. I was intending to place this on a small pedalboard with all mini pedals I have, but sounds so good it may end up moved around on ALL my pedalboards! I compared the little Decibelics Golden Horse Professional Overdrive to a nice few Klon style pedals in my collection RYRA Klone Overdrive and original Wampler Tumnus mini and the Tumnus Deluxe and found that the Decibelics Golden Horse tended to be more transparent as a clean boost. I actually though the pedal was switched off when I first plugged in my guitar! Bottomline the Decibelics Golden Horse stacks up or bests the other Klones I tested out in its mini size. Love this little pedal. sources.excerpt: Decibelics Golden Horse Klon-Style Drive | Delicious Audio Creative Pedals Creative Delay Tape Delay W/ Reverb Delay Distortion Fuzz Overdrive Dual Gain Dirt Boost Compr. + Dynamics Dynamics EQ Filter Wah Filter+EQ Lo-Fi 8 Bit Lo-fi Chorus Flanger Phaser Tremolo Uni-Vibe Modulation Pitch Shifter Octaver pitch Multiverb Reverb Spring Reverb Reverb CV In Granular Synth Pedals Synth Effect Guides Monthly Lists Shopping Guides Coverage Schedule Facebook Stompbox Exhibit Decibelics Golden Horse Klon-Style Drive Updated Feb. 14, 2024 | by Paolo De Gregorio Among the hundreds of Klon clones , the Decibelics Golden Horse stands out as both the most expensive one in mini format (at around $270 + shipping from Barcelona) and the most hyped of the bunch, which is why – unless you find it used on Reverb or eBay – the wait for it can be lengthy. Hand-made-to-order and available in many colors, this Klone sports almost the exact same components and values as a Klon Centaur #2505 from 2001, but packed in a case that’s around 1/4th the size of the original. Each unit is tested against that pedal before is shipped out. Geeks among you can find more information about the components used in the Specs section at the bottom of this post. Due to its size, it doesn’t accept batteries, but the builder can provide an external adapter for 9v DC fans – the latter could alternatively buy the Golden Royale , which is a double channel version of the Golden Horse with extra features, including a battery slot. We added the Decibelics Golden Horse to our shortlist of the best Klon Centaur clones .
